products.description:
Run ADFS SSO for Microsoft 365 — or retire it to cloud auth cleanly

Many enterprises still sign in to Microsoft 365 through ADFS — and it's a single point of failure that's often better replaced by cloud authentication. This solution covers both: deploy and troubleshoot ADFS federation (claims rules, token-signing certs, WAP proxy, endpoints), and — when you're ready — migrate to managed authentication (Password Hash Sync or Pass-through Auth with Seamless SSO, staged rollout) and decommission ADFS — so M365 sign-in is reliable and, ideally, simpler.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — ADFS federation for M365 (claims, certs, WAP), its failure modes, and the managed-auth alternatives (PHS/PTA + Seamless SSO) with the staged-migration model.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (ADFS/WAP + AD, Azure AD Connect, Global Admin, certificates, pilot group).
  • Implementation Guide — validate/repair ADFS (claims rules, token-signing cert rollover, endpoints, WAP), OR run the staged conversion to PHS/PTA + Seamless SSO (staged rollout, verify, convert domains) and decommission ADFS — pilot-first with rollback.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Exchange Online PowerShell (EXO V3) / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (federated/managed sign-in works, cert health, staged rollout verified) plus Best Practices for resilient M365 authentication.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Microsoft 365 sign-in made reliable — ADFS federation healthy and diagnosable, or cleanly retired to managed cloud auth with staged rollout — fewer moving parts, fewer outages.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • Get-M365FederationAssessment.ps1 — Discovery (READ-ONLY): produces the "Federation Assessment - M365 - Prod" snapshot of each domain's
    • Get-M365SignInMethodReport.ps1 — Reporting (READ-ONLY): consolidated report of every domain's authentication type (Federated/Managed)
    • Invoke-DomainConversionPlan.ps1 — Scope/health helper (SAFE BY DEFAULT: -WhatIf / dry-run): previews the "Domain Conversion - -
    • Invoke-TokenSigningCertRollover.ps1 — Remediation (SAFE BY DEFAULT: -WhatIf / dry-run): previews the "Token-Signing Cert - ADFS - Rollover"
    • Test-CloudAuthSignIn.ps1 — Validation (READ-ONLY): reports the effective sign-in path per domain and checks the target managed

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
